artifacts.summary: Implementation summary: the Z-time no-finite-carrier / no-finite-width fmp context note written to the formal extension's source store, registered, committed there (452d52147), deployed and verified.

completion_data.completion_summary: Wrote context/project/logic/domain/ztime-no-finite-carrier-fmp.md (397 lines) into the formal extension's source store, registered it in index-entries.json and the logic README, committed the three files there (452d52147), redeployed (landed_verify_clean) and verified the deployed copy byte-identical and indexed. The note records both machine-checked refutations (finite carrier via Probe706/theta, finite width via Probe710/Phi), the strengthened design rule (infinite finitely presented carrier is necessary but not sufficient; finite fibres remain incomplete for targets carrying stab), the time-sliced-graph diagnosis, the published counterpart (GKWZ repeating finite pieces, HWZ quasimodel over Z), and the explicit warning that fmp failure is not undecidability (Krommes 2020; GKWZ 5.28/5.32 verified with page numbers).

memory_candidates.content: Context notes for the formal extension are written to the source store (~/.config/nvim/agent-system/extensions/formal/context/project/logic/domain/), registered by appending one entry to that extension's index-entries.json (jq '.entries += [...]' preserves the file's 2-space formatting so the diff is only the new entry) plus one README line, committed in the ~/.config/nvim repository by explicit path, then redeployed with deploy-headless.sh and verified with cmp against the deployed copy and a grep of .claude/context/index.json. The task-reference lint pattern is only literal 'task N' phrasing; probe namespaces (Probe706) and specs/NNN_... paths pass.

Three distinct obstructions to a finite Z-time certificate class, routinely conflated: carrier SIZE (theta; no finite graph hosts a countermodel; repaired by Z x Fin n via FrameOver.ofSlicedStep), ALL-THREADS FULFILMENT (pumpTarget; repaired by liveness as a fixpoint over live positions), and finite WIDTH (Phi; limit closure plus finite fibres contradicts Koenig; NOT repaired by any landed class). The carrier rule alone is necessary but not sufficient. Also: fmp failure is not undecidability (K4 x S5 lacks the product fmp yet is EXPSPACE-complete).
